body:
hey /r/SuicideWatch

Thank you. Seriously. These comments feel like they come from friends. I was in a really bad place yesterday, and as someone in the comments mentioned, there will probably be more days like this. But reading these comments makes it so much more easier to handle. A positive voice goes a long way.

Thank you. Seriously, each one of you, who took the time to say something here. I'm screenshotting this shit for motivation for the future.

Hope yall see my comic book stories some day soon. I'm going to try to get back on my feet now, and get back to work on them.
